vt1105b.title: Canon EOS M White Mirrorless Camera EF-M 22mm f/2 STM and 18-55mm IS STM Lenses
vt1105b.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vt1105b.details: Canon EOS M mirrorless camera in white, a 18-megapixel APS-C model, sold as a double lens kit with the EF-M 22mm f/2 STM pancake lens and the EF-M 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6 IS STM zoom lens. Condition: pre-owned with light signs of use on the body and the mount, as shown in the photos, and no major scratches. Operation was checked: the camera powers on, and the rear screen shows the live view and the menus. The menu language can be set to English, Japanese or Chinese. The battery is old, so battery life is not guaranteed. Included, as shown in the photos: camera body, Canon EF-M 22mm f/2 STM lens, Canon EF-M 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6 IS STM lens, Canon LC-E12 battery charger, a battery and the Canon strap. No box, manual, body cap, lens caps, flash or memory card is included. Please see the photos for the exact condition.
vt1105b.why: A used white Canon EOS M with two EF-M lenses, a charger and a strap.
vt1105b.perfect: Beginners and travelers who want a compact interchangeable-lens camera with a fast pancake lens.
vt1105b.exp: A pre-owned Canon EOS M double lens kit in the condition described above.
